value.original: Export as Primavera P6 PMXML (APIBusinessObjects XML) — the format every documented P6 export path uses; re-imports here too. Some fields (WBS code, EPS-level activity codes, resource assignments, global calendars, baselines) are not carried — P6 itself drops most of these on cross-DB import.

row.value: Eksport sebagai Primavera P6 PMXML (XML APIBusinessObjects) — format yang digunakan setiap laluan eksport P6 yang didokumenkan; boleh diimport semula di sini juga. Sesetengah medan (kod WBS, kod aktiviti peringkat EPS, tugasan sumber, kalendar global, garis dasar) tidak dibawa — P6 sendiri menggugurkan kebanyakannya semasa import antara DB.

value.original: Export as Primavera XER — the older tab-delimited P6 interchange, for P6 installs that still prefer it over PMXML. Same known-lossy fields as PMXML.

value.original: Critical Path Method, recomputed after every edit. Red = zero total float: the task cannot slip without moving the project end. Green = it has slack. Project duration {pf}d · total float {minF}..{maxF}d. CPM reads the dates the drag produced — it never changes one.

Tempoh projek {pf}h · jumlah apungan {minF}..{maxF}h. CPM membaca tarikh yang dihasilkan seretan — ia tidak pernah mengubahnya.
